newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Girl, 3, found in Venezuela drug raid.
newsitem.headline: Girl, 3, found in Venezuela drug raid.

text.p: Police who stopped and searched a truck near Caracas international airport found a 3-year-old girl inside along with 16 pounds (seven kg) of cocaine, a newpaper reported on Tuesday.

The child and the drugs were abandoned by two men and a woman -- presumed to be the girl's mother -- who escaped after a scuffle with police during Monday's search, El Nacional quoted Pablo Guzman, head of the anti-drug squad, as saying.

The officers found the girl in the truck's cab and the drugs stuffed inside Christmas decorations and plaster statues. Police took the child into care and were still hunting for the men and the woman, Guzman said.
